bench_cmd: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 taskset -c 0 python3 osspr-intake/harness/bench_geometric_truncated.py
why: histogram and histogramdd call this once per bin. Each draw rechecks epsilon, bounds, and types, then Geometric.randomise checks them again, while the RNG contributes a single uniform. Skipping the repeated checks keeps the same integer noise and removes most of the time on a 12,000-bin histogram.

bench_cmd: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 taskset -c 0 python3 osspr-intake/harness/bench_exponential_utility_check.py
why: quantile builds one utility and one measure per order statistic, and Exponential scans every element with isinstance at init and again in randomise. That scan is almost the entire private quantile. A bulk numeric check does not change the probability vector or the seeded draw.

bench_cmd: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 taskset -c 0 python3 osspr-intake/harness/bench_clip_to_bounds.py
why: Mean, variance, and the models clip the training matrix before adding noise. When every feature shares the same bounds, the function copies the array and np.clip copies it again. Clipping the input once returns the same array and drops about half of the bytes moved.

bench_cmd: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 taskset -c 0 python3 osspr-intake/harness/bench_bingham.py
why: PCA and covariance_eig draw a private eigenvector with this rejection sampler. Every proposal calls RandomState.multivariate_normal, which rechecks the same covariance. Passing check_valid='ignore' does not change the normal draws and removes that repeated check, about a third of an 8-d sample.
